evidence.quote: Every Meridian deployment now requires a signed release

observations.why: CTO issues a binding rule to all deployments; command enacted by rank, not by consensus or exchange.

evidence.quote: signed release manifest required for Meridian deploys

observations.why: Memo states the gate as a rule; the author's footing is unified, so the rank-based directive is the author's own.
Allocates accountability to a named person by role; rank-based assignment rather than shared or matched responsibility.
